audit.why: Emerald+ 53.85% over 91 games matches the FAV / 4-10 framing: Kassadin is a no-escape melee until 6 and Aurora out-ranges him with Twofold Hex (900) versus Null Sphere (650).

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart calls Level 6 'Skill' and 2+ items 'Aurora', but the prose in both layers says the opposite: Level 6 is Aurora's clearest kill window and 2+ items (Rod of Ages into Seraph's) is where the lane inverts.
audit.why: Riftwalk at rank 1 is a 5s cooldown and only drops to 2s at rank 3; Kassadin's real spike is items plus ult ranks, not the moment he hits 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions never reach the page: Null Sphere grants Kassadin a shield that absorbs magic damage (all of Aurora's damage), and Force Pulse charges from spells cast in his vicinity — Aurora's own poke arms his cone.
audit.why: Riot's own text: Q 'grants a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage'; E 'draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity'.
audit.corrected: Bait Null Sphere (9s at rank 1) with a throwaway Q before the real recast, and expect Force Pulse (21s at rank 1) after you have poked — your casts charged it.

audit.why: Real numbers make the advice actionable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aurora's tradeBad reads 'it is your KA answer; without it you are a immobile drain bot' — corrupted template text, and the matching Don't is titled 'R defensively for nothing' while its body describes the W hop.
audit.why: Title and body describe different abilities; the sentence is ungrammatical.
audit.corrected: Split them: the Don't is about Between Worlds (140s at rank 1), the trade rule is about Across the Veil (22s at rank 1).
